mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate earnings valuation.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <= 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 5.0% triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations, causing immediate equity sell-offs as investors price in higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 5.0% (y/y) and 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous consumer demand strength (RSAFS > 650,000 million dollars) and housing market expansion (HOUST > 1,500 thousand units) signal robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 650000 and HOUST > 1500 and 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) activates monetary policy easing expectations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate rate cuts to stimulate economic activity.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0 and 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates strengthening manufacturing output, correlating with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved economic momentum.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 and 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST < 1,500 thousand units) signal weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks increase and corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1500 and 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) indicate active monetary easing to combat labor market weakness, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through anticipated rate cuts.
regime_hint: monetary easing in response to labor weakness
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5 and FEDFUNDS < 2.5 and 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 100) signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth expectations decline and recession risks rise.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.
